title: plugin-charts: a page-level dataset `object-chart` orders a select dimension by its stored value (高 / 低 / 中 / 紧急), while the dashboard's dataset widget uses the declared option order (#11809)
body:
Filing-gate: ① product defect · reach: the showcase command center page (`showcase_command_center`), panels 优先级分布 and 状态分布, as admin
Reader: objectui triage seat → the lane that owns `packages/plugin-charts` (`ObjectChart.tsx`); `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` already builds the `categoryOrder` that `ChartRenderer` / `AdvancedChartImpl` accept
Duplicate search: semantic search "dashboard chart select field categories sorted by raw value instead of option order" in objectui, incl. closed → 12 hits. #11809 (closed) fixed dashboards and grid grouping, and #12243 (closed) fixed report tables. Neither covers the page block.

Measured during an exploratory showcase walkthrough on 2026-10-23: objectstack `main` b9c7a8f (`PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, stock showcase), objectui `main` 6fb31dc console (Vite dev, :5180), locale zh-CN.

## What happens

The command center draws `object-chart` blocks bound to the dataset `showcase_task_metrics`. With dimension `priority`, the bars read **高, 低, 中, 紧急**, which is the alphabetical order of the stored values `high, low, medium, urgent`. With dimension `status`, they read 待规划, 已完成, 进行中, …. The Chart Gallery and the dashboards draw the same fields in declared option order (低 → 中 → 高 → 紧急).

## Where

`DatasetWidget.tsx` (the dashboard path) computes `categoryOrder: buildCategoryOrder(firstDimOptions)` from the dimension's field options (objectui#11809). `AdvancedChartImpl` honours it through `buildCategoryRank(categoryOrder)`. `ObjectChart.tsx`, which renders a page-level `object-chart` with a `dataset`, already resolves the dimension's field options for labels and colours, but it never passes a `categoryOrder`. So the page path falls back to the dataset's GROUP BY order.

## Expected

A page-level dataset chart orders a select dimension the same way the dashboard widget does.
